$comment: Schema version: v1. Policy documents declare it via standard.version. Canonical form: repoforge.schema.yaml; repoforge.schema.json is derived from it.
title: RepoForge Repository Contract
description: Declarative policy describing the desired state of a RepoForge-managed GitHub repository. Validated deterministically (spec.md §9.3). Unknown fields are rejected: every object sets additionalProperties to false. Defaults are annotations consumed by RepoForge tooling; an omitted field behaves exactly as if set to its documented default (spec.md §9.4).

standard.description: Identifies the standard and the schema version the policy conforms to.

name.description: Name of the engineering standard this policy conforms to. Forks of the standard set their own name.

version.description: Repository contract schema version. Tooling must reject policies declaring an unknown version (spec.md §9.2).

repository.description: Core repository identity and governance settings.

governance_profile.description: Named governance profile, realized by the GitHub governance model: configs/github/<profile>.yaml layered onto configs/github/repository.yaml (docs/architecture/github-governance.md).

visibility.description: Desired repository visibility. Changing visibility is a security-sensitive operation (spec.md §8.5): doctor audits it, bootstrap never changes it silently.

default_branch.description: The default branch. The standard's own Git model requires "main" (spec.md §6.1); other values are possible for managed repositories but deviate from the standard.

merge.description: Merge methods and post-merge behavior. At least one merge method must be enabled. GitHub setting names given in descriptions must be verified against the current GitHub API before implementation (spec.md §7.2).

squash.description: Allow squash merging (GitHub: allow_squash_merge). The standard's preferred method (pull-requests.md, M1).

merge_commit.description: Allow merge commits (GitHub: allow_merge_commit). Disabled by default (pull-requests.md, M2).

rebase.description: Allow rebase merging (GitHub: allow_rebase_merge). Disabled by default (pull-requests.md, M3).

delete_branch.description: Delete head branches after merge (GitHub: delete_branch_on_merge; pull-requests.md, M4).

linear_history.description: Require linear history on the default branch (GitHub branch protection: required_linear_history). Requires branch protection; incompatible with merge_commit enabled.

auto_merge.description: Allow auto-merge on pull requests (GitHub: allow_auto_merge). Only effective with required status checks.

git.description: Git authorship conventions. Enforcement is via CI lint (planned) and review until then.

commit_style.description: Commit message convention. v1 supports only the restricted Conventional Commits subset in docs/development/commit-conventions.md. New styles are additive schema changes.

branch_style.description: Branch naming convention. v1 supports only <type>/<issue>-<description> per docs/development/branching.md.

projects.description: Enable repository Projects (GitHub: has_projects). Organization Projects are not modeled in v1.

security.description: Security feature configuration. All operations in this section are security-sensitive (spec.md §8.5): individually planned and confirmed by bootstrap, audited by doctor.

dependabot.description: Dependabot vulnerability alerts and security updates. Version updates additionally require a dependabot.yml, modeled under ownership.managed_paths.

code_scanning.description: Code scanning (CodeQL default setup). Free for public repositories; private repositories require a GitHub Advanced Security license.

secret_scanning.description: Secret scanning. Free for public repositories; private repositories require GitHub Advanced Security.

secret_scanning_push_protection.description: Secret scanning push protection. Requires secret_scanning enabled.

dependency_review.description: Dependency review on pull requests via CI. Requires the dependency graph (enabled by default for public repositories).

private_vulnerability_reporting.description: Private vulnerability reporting (Security tab → Report a vulnerability). Documented for public repositories; on other repositories availability is determined by GitHub at apply time and failures surface explicitly, never silently.

scorecard.description: OpenSSF Scorecard analysis workflow. Primarily meaningful for public repositories; requires a workflow file under ownership.managed_paths.

action_pinning.description: Required pinning for GitHub Actions. "sha" requires full-length commit SHAs (spec.md §8.6). Enforced by CI lint (planned).

strategy.description: "none": no releases. "tag": annotated SemVer tags only. "github-release": annotated tags plus a GitHub release per tag.

kind.description: Informational in v1; may drive template and doctor behavior in later schema versions. Enum growth is additive.

ownership.description: Path ownership model (spec.md §5). Entries are gitignore-style glob patterns relative to the repository root. On overlap, precedence is: user_owned_paths, then managed_paths, then scaffolded_paths.

managed_paths.description: Paths owned by the policy: bootstrap creates and updates them, validate checks them, manual edits are drift (spec.md §5.2).

scaffolded_paths.description: Paths generated once (template or first bootstrap) and then owned by the user; tooling never updates them after creation.

user_owned_paths.description: Paths tooling must never create, modify, or delete (spec.md §5.3).

placeholder_paths.description: Paths permitted to contain unresolved template placeholders (the double-brace syntax used by the template builder). Intended for template sources, such as the engine repository itself. In generated repositories this list is normally empty: placeholders there are unresolved-template bugs flagged by validate.
